fr_html: M. HAGERUP déclare qu'à son avis il convient de suivre l'ordre du jour proposé par le Président. Il pense qu'il serait prématuré de déposer des projets formulés. Il faut d'abord terminer la discussion de la question fondamentale. Personnellement, M. Hagerup peut se rallier — provisoirement bien entendu — à la proposition de Mr. Root et de Lord Phillimore, mais c'est là une concession de sa part. Il croit que le moment où l'on est en train de faire des concessions n'est pas celui où il convient de formuler des projets.
en_html: M. HAGERUP said that in his opinion the agenda proposed by the President should be followed. He thought that the submission of formulated projects would be premature. First of all, the discussion of the fundamental question must be finished. As far as he was concerned, M. Hagerup felt that he could, provisionally, agree to the proposal of Mr. Root and Lord Phillimore; this however would be a concession on his part. He thought that the time when concessions were being considered was not the time to put forward a project.
